voice.speaker: firstad
voice.caption: Book twelve. The Sirens. Rowers, stroke.

voice.speaker: director
voice.caption: Action.

voice.speaker: director
voice.caption: They look like a loop.

voice.speaker: cinematographer
voice.caption: One clock. A stroke every two point six seconds.

voice.speaker: crew-at-the-oars-2
voice.caption: I'm four hundredths of a stroke late.

voice.speaker: crew-at-the-oars-3
voice.caption: Three hundredths of a stroke early.

voice.speaker: crew-at-the-oars-5
voice.caption: I don't row. I steer.

voice.speaker: the-sirens-4
voice.caption: We sing on a clock of our own.

voice.speaker: director
voice.caption: Print it.

voice.speaker: crew-at-the-oars-2
voice.caption: What?

voice.speaker: firstad
voice.caption: Wax in their ears. It's in the scene.

voice.speaker: firstad
voice.caption: I'll check on all of you at the top of the hour.

voice.speaker: firstad
voice.caption: Book five, on the same boat. Calypso, your trees. Odysseus, beside her.

voice.speaker: director
voice.caption: Action.

voice.speaker: calypso
voice.caption: Here at the island's edge the tall trees stand: alder, and poplar, and sky-high fir.

voice.speaker: director
voice.caption: Where is Calypso?

voice.speaker: cinematographer
voice.caption: Behind the back of his head.

voice.speaker: odysseus
voice.caption: I'm the lead.

voice.speaker: cinematographer
voice.caption: Take one. Twenty-four seconds of her lines, behind his head.

voice.speaker: calypso
voice.caption: Seven years I kept him. One take, and he's in front of me.

voice.speaker: director
voice.caption: Apart.

voice.speaker: firstad
voice.caption: He means: a man's height apart.

voice.speaker: calypso
voice.caption: Here at the island's edge the tall trees stand: alder, and poplar, and sky-high fir.

voice.speaker: cinematographer
voice.caption: Her face. And the bow on his back is still across the frame.

voice.speaker: director
voice.caption: Keep it.

voice.speaker: odysseus
voice.caption: Do I still get the raft?

voice.speaker: calypso
voice.caption: Four days. You build it yourself.

voice.speaker: firstad
voice.caption: That's a wrap on the sea.

voice.speaker: crew-at-the-oars-5
voice.caption: I'll steer us home.
